method: 10 and 20 isolated actual Chrome contexts with CDP virtual focus making real document.visibilityState visible; API RTT 75ms; product timers unchanged; >=65 seconds steady per cohort

baselineUserProvided.note: User-provided aggregate; D1 queries are not Worker HTTP requests. No observed increase may be equated directly with this query count.

limits: No operating API requests or production D1 operations.
CDP visibility emulation isolates simultaneous foreground behavior; this is not a measured fleet of physical devices.
Native app launch and physical GPS remain mocked.
Measured Worker endpoint requests need actual per-endpoint D1 SQL metrics before calculating D1 row-read cost.
Continuous hour/day figures extrapolate 65 seconds, exclude ten-minute refresh boundary and user interactions; they are scenarios, not observed traffic.
